name: education-platform
description: Repo-level tooling (the Supabase CLI). The web app has its own package in web/.

scripts.fn:test: deno check --node-modules-dir=none supabase/functions/ai/index.ts && deno test --node-modules-dir=none supabase/functions
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types --lang typescript --schema public > web/src/supabase/database.types.ts && cd web && npx prettier --write src/supabase/database.types.ts
